source_name: 73_01_图片库＆设计资源_中文_女士_Chanel_Pre-Summer_2027_服装__073_media_cha_biarritz_ps27_069_text_description.md
text_description: A tailored matching black knit look is shown on the body, composed of a close-fitting long-sleeve cropped top and a high-waisted mini skirt. The top has a wide shallow crew or boat neckline edged with layered contrast trim in cream and red, lightly dropped shoulders, slim sleeves, and a cropped hem ending just above a pale cream belt at the waist. The knit surface appears softly textured with subtle horizontal ribbed or banded areas across the chest and sleeves. The sleeve ends feature bold stacked horizontal stripes in cream, black, and red, creating a coordinated cuff effect at the forearms. The skirt sits high on the waist beneath the belt, continues the black textured knit, and falls to a short mini length with a slightly uneven or angled front hem impression; its lower portion is decorated with multiple horizontal bands in cream, red, and black, echoing the neckline and cuffs. A light cream belt with a gold interlocking monogram-style buckle defines the waist and separates the cropped top from the skirt. Accessories include round dark sunglasses, large dangling statement earrings, and a structured rectangular handbag carried at the side, with a black textured body and a contrasting pale quilted or embossed upper section. The overall styling is polished and coordinated, balancing a compact knit silhouette with graphic striped trim and gold-accented accessories.
